Value-path constant cache against the uncached kernel (test hook)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
dot-linCmtValueCacheCheck.Rd

Steps one kernel object through the rows of par with the theta-keyed constant cache linCmtA() uses, and another through the uncached evaluation, both from alast0 with infusion rate.

Usage

.linCmtValueCacheCheck(dt, par, ncmt, oral0, trans, alast0, rate)

Arguments

dt

row time steps

par

numeric matrix, one row of (p1, v1, p2, p3, p4, p5, ka) per step

ncmt

number of compartments

oral0

1 for a depot, else 0

trans

parameterization code

alast0

starting amounts

rate

infusion rates

Value

list with cached and direct, the amounts after each step (one row per step)
